House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Children and Families Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to food support; appropriating money for infrastructure for food shelf facilities.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; CAPITAL FOR EMERGENCY FOOD DISTRIBUTION FACILITIES. +]

[+$....... in fiscal year 2026 and $....... in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of children, youth, and families for grants to improve and expand infrastructure of food shelf facilities. Grant money must be made available to nonprofit organizations, federally recognized Tribes, and local units of government. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to food support; appropriating money for infrastructure for food shelf facilities.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; CAPITAL FOR EMERGENCY FOOD DISTRIBUTION FACILITIES.

$....... in fiscal year 2026 and $....... in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of children, youth, and families for grants to improve and expand infrastructure of food shelf facilities. Grant money must be made available to nonprofit organizations, federally recognized Tribes, and local units of government.
